items.title: How Can Managers Support Team Learning in the Age of AI?
items.excerpt: AI can reduce the time it takes to create code and documents. For a team using AI, a crucial part of its work is experimenting and making decisions. Managers, in turn, need to create an environment in which the team can keep learning in pursuit of the outcomes customers desire.
